description: This file defines the McpHub class responsible for managing MCP server connections, including OAuth authentication, server configuration validation, file watching, and reconnection logic within a VSCode extension environment.

classes.name: McpHub
classes.description: Manages MCP server connections, including OAuth, configuration validation, file watching, and reconnection strategies within a VSCode extension.

methods.name: initializeOAuthService
methods.description: Initializes the OAuth service if a context is available.

methods.name: getOAuthTokensForServer
methods.description: Retrieves OAuth tokens for a server, refreshing if needed.

methods.name: initiateOAuthForServer
methods.description: Starts OAuth flow for a server requiring authentication.

methods.name: clearOAuthTokens
methods.description: Clears stored OAuth tokens for a server.

methods.name: initiateOAuthSignIn
methods.description: Performs OAuth sign-in for a server by name, restarting connection upon success.

methods.name: buildAuthStatus
methods.description: Builds the authentication status object for a server.

methods.name: isOAuthRequiredError
methods.description: Determines if an error indicates OAuth authentication is required.

methods.name: extractWwwAuthenticateHeader
methods.description: Extracts WWW-Authenticate header from an error object.

methods.name: normalizeTokenType
methods.description: Normalizes OAuth token type casing for HTTP headers.

methods.name: scheduleReconnect
methods.description: Schedules an exponential backoff reconnect attempt for a disconnected server.

methods.name: cancelReconnect
methods.description: Cancels scheduled reconnect attempts for a server.

methods.name: resetReconnectAttempts
methods.description: Resets the reconnect attempt counter after a successful connection.

methods.name: registerClient
methods.description: Registers a client using this hub, increasing reference count.

methods.name: unregisterClient
methods.description: Unregisters a client, decreasing reference count and disposing if zero.

methods.name: validateServerConfig
methods.description: Validates and normalizes server configuration, throwing errors on invalid data.

methods.name: showErrorMessage
methods.description: Logs and displays error messages.

methods.name: setupWorkspaceFoldersWatcher
methods.description: Sets up watcher for workspace folder changes.

methods.name: debounceConfigChange
methods.description: Debounces configuration file change handling.

methods.name: handleConfigFileChange
methods.description: Handles updates to configuration files, parsing and validating.

methods.name: watchProjectMcpFile
methods.description: Watches for changes in the project MCP configuration file.

methods.name: updateProjectMcpServers
methods.description: Updates project MCP servers based on configuration file.

methods.name: cleanupProjectMcpServers
methods.description: Removes all project MCP servers and disconnects.

methods.name: getServers
methods.description: Returns enabled MCP servers, deduplicated with project servers taking priority.

methods.name: getAllServers
methods.description: Returns all MCP servers regardless of state.

methods.name: getMcpServersPath
methods.description: Gets the directory path for MCP servers.

methods.name: getMcpSettingsFilePath
methods.description: Gets or creates the MCP settings file path.

methods.name: watchMcpSettingsFile
methods.description: Watches for changes in the global MCP settings file.

methods.name: initializeMcpServers
methods.description: Initializes MCP servers from configuration files.
